resources.string: VIRTUAL VAULT • NO REAL MONEY • NOT FOR REAL PAYMENTS

Vault Card is a fictional virtual card and marketplace entertainment app. We use Google Sign-In via Firebase Authentication solely to persist your virtual cards, in-app balances, virtual storefronts, orders, and support tickets in your isolated Cloud Firestore workspace. We never collect real credit card numbers, real bank accounts, CVVs, or process real financial transactions. Camera access is used strictly on-device when you scan QR codes, and gallery QR uploads use the zero-permission Android Photo Picker. You may reset your wallet data or sign out at any time from your Profile.

By using Vault Card, you acknowledge that all virtual cards, card numbers, expiry dates, CVV codes, dollar balances, coins, badges, receipts, and orders are 100% fictional and exist solely for entertainment inside this app. Virtual funds have zero real-world monetary value and cannot be withdrawn, transferred, or accepted by real merchants, banks, or payment networks. Automated support responses are generated by AI for in-app guidance and are clearly distinguished from support tickets.

Data Safety Summary:
• Account Info (Google UID and display name): Collected for authentication and syncing your virtual wallet.
• App Activity (Virtual cards, in-app orders, transactions, and support tickets): Stored securely in Cloud Firestore with user-scoped rules.
• Camera: Optional, used only on-device for live QR scanning (no images are uploaded).
• Financial Info: No real financial, bank, or payment data is ever collected or processed.
